in_sanskrit.name: Atya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Fearless, Invincible
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Atya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Atya is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘ati’ which means ‘beyond’ or ‘higher’. It is a name given to the brave and fearless, one who is invincible in the face of adversity. This name is also associated with the goddess Durga, who is the embodiment of fearlessness and strength.
